relevance_note: Single-patient case report of a female with SSADH deficiency diagnosed biochemically ("SSADH deficiency was documented in peripheral blood leucocytes"); no ALDH5A1 variant is printed.
method_note: Read the whole letter by hand; no tables. One in-scope person, labelled 'patient' (rule 5). No variant rows: the paper names no ALDH5A1 variant and does not tie any variant to her (diagnosis by GHB excretion and leucocyte enzyme assay), so the v3 'not reported' variant row does not apply. n_patients_reported left null because the field counts patients with an ALDH5A1 variant and none is printed (one patient with SSADH deficiency is described). cites_prior_report set true because her diagnosis is cited to ref 9 (Gibson 1988, 'a patient without ataxia or convulsions'); the letter does not say in so many words that she was described there; the reference title was not used as evidence about her. Time points: exam at 9 years 2 months; follow-up at 29 years. Hyperactivity was observed at 9 years and has remitted by 29 years (time-dependent, recorded as observed with the remission in severity_or_detail, not as a contradiction). Normal findings recorded as excluded abnormalities (D-27): fundi/disks, peripheral sensation, muscle strength, appendicular and truncal coordination, plantar responses, sleep schedule, head MRI. Checklist 'ataxia' left not reported: normal appendicular and truncal coordination does not explicitly address gait ataxia (narrow vs broad rule). Checklist MRI items left not reported: the MRI is reported normal only as a whole ('normal T_l, T_2, and balanced-pulse sequences'), so it is recorded as such without excluding the specific checklist findings. Checklist 'sleep disturbances' left not reported: 'Sleep schedule is normal' sits beside 'occasional extended sleep periods last 12 to 15 hours'. 'repetitive behavior' not mapped to autism. Mask-like facies is attributed by the authors possibly to thioridazine. Adult features come from caregivers ('These observations emanate from caregivers'). No contradictions found.
